name: Markdown Table of Contents Generator CLI
description: A command-line tool that parses Markdown files, extracts headings, generates a formatted table of contents with anchor links, ignores code blocks, handles malformed/empty files, and outputs to stdout or file.
acceptance_criteria: Parse Markdown file and extract level 1 to level 3 headings (#, ##, ###).
Generate a formatted markdown list with properly indented anchor links (e.g. - [Title](#title)).
Properly ignore heading markers occurring inside fenced code blocks (```).
Handle empty input files gracefully by exiting cleanly (code 0) without exceptions.
Handle non-existent input files cleanly by reporting an error to stderr and exiting with code 1.
Support standard CLI invocation via main.py with --help option exiting code 0.
Report usage error and exit code 2 when required file argument is missing.
Include automated behavioral unit tests in test_main.py covering normal and edge cases.
